prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Zirconium (지르코늄) itself — the sovereign of the Zirconium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: zirconium: a hard, corrosion-proof silver-grey metal named from a Persian word for gold-coloured, after the golden zircon gems of Ceylon in which it was found in 1789; zircon grains lock in uranium but shut out lead as they crystallize, so they keep time, and tiny grains from red Australian hills are about 4.4 billion years old, the oldest memories of the first solid Earth; zircon is also gathered from beach sands; melted zirconia grows into cubic zirconia, a flawless stone that throws even more rainbow fire than the diamond it imitates; the metal lets neutrons pass and so clads reactor fuel, once its near-identical twin hafnium is removed. Palette: honey-gold zircon, hyacinth red-brown, diamond-white rainbow fire, cool zirconium silver.

World (fixed): a kingdom of the oldest memory among red desert hills: weathered red rock studded with tiny golden crystal grains that still remember the day the first ground set solid, a temple built around a giant hourglass of those grains, rock walls carved in gold with the oldest stories. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) leather armor with a short cloak, a lowered hood, bracers and boots — a light, agile ranger's silhouette; 2) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 3) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 4) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 5) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette; 6) a great crown and a fur-trimmed royal mantle over an ornate breastplate — a ceremonial, regal silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): honey-gold zircon, hyacinth red-brown, diamond-white rainbow fire, cool zirconium silver.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): honey-gold hair with deep hyacinth red-brown lowlights and a hard, diamond-bright sparkle. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Zr) and atomic number (40) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Chosen original design: wing-ornament silhouette (option 3). Her metal feather wings are interlocking translucent zircon facets whose nested growth zones resemble ancient geological rings; honey-gold and silver frame with hyacinth red-brown insets. Hair in a thick side braid with swept side fringe, same fixed colours. Oval adult face, warm olive skin, narrow emerald almond eyes, calm confident smile. Arms relaxed separately, empty hands visible. Full body front three-quarter view on a sunlit red-rock temple bridge over golden sand channels, giant hourglass distant. No crown needed; wing-shaped head ornament. Use this concrete design for the image.
